messages:
maria-g: quick Q — we need to finalize how the runtime signals a soft/burst grace window vs a hard 429. currently we only emit Retry-After on hard rejects. thinking of adding an optional header so clients can make better fallback choices. any concerns?

samir: +1 to clarifying this. naming matters though. calling it 'Grace' sounds vague. prefer X-RateLimit-Soft or X-RateLimit-Burst-Window with units. keep it optional and backwards compatible.

jonah: from routing side: also useful to know scope (route vs account). can we include X-RateLimit-Scope: route|account ? that avoids client guessing.

lara: SDK POV — we prefer very explicit units (ms vs s) and a single numeric header rather than JSON. parsing arbitrary structured headers will be a pain across languages.

sdk-team: current JS SDK treats any 429 as retryable with exp backoff (up to 30s). if we expose a soft window we can surface it as `softRetryAfterMs` so apps can choose degrade/cheaper-model fallback instead of retrying.

maria-g: suggested proposal (minimal, optional headers):

```
X-RateLimit-Scope: route
X-RateLimit-Burst-Remaining: 12   # integer tokens left in burst bucket
X-RateLimit-Soft-Ms: 1200         # soft window remaining in ms (0 if none)
```

these would only be returned on 429 or when the runtime is in a soft-degrade mode. hard 429s still include Retry-After. thoughts on names?

samir: X-RateLimit-Soft-Ms looks fine. prefer explicit `-Ms` suffix to avoid timezone/confusion. Burst-Remaining is useful for dashboards. we should also emit X-RateLimit-Bucket to correlate logs (opaque id).

jonah: agree on bucket id for tracing: X-RateLimit-Bucket: bkt-abc123. also, make sure per-route overrides don't leak internal capacity semantics. keep wording: 'may be omitted' and 'best-effort'.

lara: small SDK nit: if Soft-Ms is present and >0 we'll surface as advisory. recommend we document expected client behavior:
- treat soft as advisory: attempt degrade (cheaper model / lower tokens) rather than immediate retry
- on hard Retry-After follow existing retry rules

sdk-team: will update SDK to map headers -> RateLimit object. prefer integer ms header name exactly `X-RateLimit-Soft-Ms`. also will add helper: `isSoft()` and `softMs` fields.

maria-g: rollout plan idea: feature-flag the header (canary region only) for 2 weeks, then enable globally. runtime to only send when we enter 'soft-degrade' state to avoid noise.

jonah: +1. add a logging flag so we can measure client adoption before global flip.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout started for runtime change (eu-west-1). sha: ab12cd3.

maria-g: thanks — I'll open a tiny RFC + docs PR with the exact header names, examples, and client guidance. pinging @sdk-team for any blocking issues; will ship after SDK signoff. :thumbsup:

sdk-team: no blockers, will try to have a patch in the JS and Python SDKs by EOD Wed.

maria-g: perfect. follow-ups: (1) PR link when created (2) add integr tests to ensure headers are omitted when not in soft mode.

lara: adding one more example for docs — client fallback snippet: `if (softMs > 0) { callCheaperModel(); } else { retryWithBackoff(); }`

maria-g: awesome, thanks all!"
